name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hmm... I was sure she'd be here, but nope..."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Hm? Wait, didn't this place have a slide or a jungle gym or something?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...Yeah, right, it definitely did. I jumped off the jungle gym once and broke my leg."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "...No, wait, was it somewhere else? Man, I barely remember things from back when I was a kid."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "My folks never bought me video games and stuff, so I used to play at places like this a lot when I was little."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Oh, right! I pumped the swing way too hard once and sent myself flying! Crazy how wild I was."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Ain't it the same for you? You ever do stuff like that?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "I had a bestie, y'see. We'd do all kinds of stupid, dangerous stuff together. We were always chasing thrills back then. Kinda nostalgic."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "But yeah, there's no way I could do that now. Even sandboxes freak me out. Like, there's definitely cat poop buried in there or something. Way too scary."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Okay, now I'm rambling. Anyway, we probably shouldn't hang around here too long."

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Y'know, a certain someone might show up, someone I'm pretty sure you don't wanna see, yeah?"

name: Gyaruko-san
message: "Shiorin ain't here, so let's hurry up and get a move on."
